column1: # Every Claude Code skill on Karol's Mac Studio. This repository is the one place each skill is edited.
# Columns, separated by one tab: name, status, folder (relative to ~/Projects), note.
#   active   the skill's source of truth, a folder of this repository: install.sh links it into ~/.claude/skills
#   copy     a copy another project carries (MxScout ships its skills, Tandem's code reads its own): written only by
#            node bin/skills.js publish; never edit it there (bin/skills.js check sees it, pull brings it back here)
#   retired  kept for history and Tandem's knowledge base, never linked
# Atlas (Skille) and Tandem's knowledge base read this file too.
